An air force officer who led a junior officers' uprising on 4 June 1979, handed power to an elected government months later, and seized it again on 31 December 1981, ruling until 2001.

His 1979 regime executed eight senior officers, including three former heads of state, for corruption. After 1981 his government jailed and killed opponents at first, then from 1983 adopted the reforms of the IMF and World Bank, and Ghana's economy recovered. He brought in the 1992 constitution, won two elections, and stepped down after two terms, when his party lost the election of 2000. He remained a popular and outspoken figure until his death.
sum: An air force officer who led a junior officers' uprising on 4 June 1979, handed power to an elected government months later, and seized it again on 31 December 1981, ruling until 2001.
